turns.learner: Hi! Can we learn finding a name, time or place in a short message today?
turns.tutor:
Hi! Yes, let's practise. One tip first: read the whole question before you look at the message. A message can have many times and places, but only one fits the question.

Read the message. What day is the game?

"Hi Mona! The football game is on Thursday. It is not on Monday this week. Ali brings the ball at 5:15. The game starts at 5:30. Meet me at the sports hall, not at the gate. Bring 3 friends and 1 bottle of water. From Jamal"
